messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: HOSTED-KVPOOL7 memory > 95% (OOMs). Error spike in hosted-runtime (500s on generation). Alerts: kvcache_heap_growth, continuous-batch-queue-length. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/kvcache-oom

eve_oncall: I'm on it. paging in. checking console and pods now.

ben_sre: scope? single pool or across regions?

alice_ml: I saw increased kvcache prefetch rates on canaries after the continuous-batching v2 rollout ~03:07UTC earlier. Could be related.

frank_engineer: logs from pool7 show a small set of sessions with extremely long prompts (>>100k tokens) repeatedly hitting prefetch + KV span growth. prefetched spans grew unbounded.

dinesh_runtime: confirmed — deploy at 03:07:12 enabled `continuous_batching=v2` in hosted runtime for all pools in the rollout group. Canary was green but not wide.

carol_support: customer impact: 4 customers seeing 500s (chatty.ai, docsummarize, learnerx, legalbot). Support already triaging; will open follow-up tickets.

eve_oncall: root cause hypothesis: cbv2 changes + long prompts => runaway prefetch + kvcache footprint blowup => OOMs. Need immediate mitigation before stateful restarts.

ben_sre: mitigation options: 1) kill offending sessions + evict their KV, 2) toggle continuous-batching back to v1, 3) apply aggressive eviction / lower span cap, 4) scale pool (but that is slow).

frank_engineer: we can quickly flip `CONTINUOUS_BATCHING=legacy` via config API and set `kvcache.max_span_tokens=2000` and `kvcache.prefetch_enabled=false` as a fallback. That should stop new prefetched spans.

eve_oncall: doing option 2+3 now. applying config patch to hosted-runtime config. will roll to pool7 first.

frank_engineer: snippet to apply config (internal):
```
redwoodctl config set hosted-runtime CONTINUOUS_BATCHING=legacy --target pool7
redwoodctl config set hosted-runtime KVCACHE_MAX_SPAN=2000 --target pool7
redwoodctl config set hosted-runtime KVCACHE_PREFETCH=false --target pool7
```

eve_oncall: ran the three commands on pool7. patch accepted. waiting for config propagation (approx 15s).

incident-bot: config-change: CONTINUOUS_BATCHING -> legacy on pool7 by eve_oncall at 1765433375.

ben_sre: seeing immediate drop in prefetch rate on pool7 graphs. memory delta starting to decrease.

carol_support: continue with customer comms: temporary degraded throughput, but errors dropping. sending updates to affected accounts now.

alice_ml: can we also evict the top noisy sessions? I can run a targeted eviction of sessions with abnormal KV size.

frank_engineer: agree — run `kvcache evict --pool pool7 --filter "kv_tokens>50000"` to clear the worst offenders.

eve_oncall: evict command executed. 12 sessions evicted, freed ~42GB across pool7.

ben_sre: memory back to normal band after ~90s. error rate trending to baseline. latency up ~15% briefly while batching reverts.

carol_support: affected customers notified, PS ticket created for chatty.ai (INC-12345).

dinesh_runtime: rolling the same config to other pools in rollout group as precaution. starting pool3, pool4, pool9.

incident-bot: rollout patch applied to pool3,pool4,pool9 at 1765433600 by dinesh_runtime.

eve_oncall: monitoring for 30m. creating a live incident page and assigning postmortem owners: frank_engineer (tech lead), alice_ml (deploy owner), ben_sre (oncall lead), carol_support (customer comms).

alice_ml: immediate next steps: revert staged continuous-batching v2 rollout, add guardrail that prevents cbv2 enabling if avg_context_len > 8k, and add automated kvcache span cap in the runtime.

frank_engineer: follow-ups: add metric `prefetch.rate_per_session` + alarm when any session > X tokens/sec, and a circuit breaker to disable prefetch for sessions with >50k tokens.

ben_sre: retro items: add canary traffic with synthetic long prompts to catch this class of regressions.

carol_support: I'll schedule the customer debrief and post the status page entry now.

eve_oncall: incident status => Mitigated at 1765433690. Will continue observation and keep this thread updated. Great work everyone. :thumbsup:

frank_engineer: logging incident as P1, postmortem to be shared within 48 hours.

alice_ml: note for postmortem — investigate why canary missed run (lack of long-prompt samples). propose adding long-context fuzzing to the eval suite.

ben_sre: closing the live pager handoff once metrics stable for 30m.

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigated -> watch period (30m). Runbook ref: https://redwood/runbooks/kvcache-oom.

carol_support: final customer update sent. will reopen if any regression.

frank_engineer: thanks team — follow-ups tracked in INC-12345 and PM-456.
